name: Vanilla baseline (12 bots)
description: Reference run for any non-vanilla comparison. All baseline behaviors on. No scripted actions, no mod-specific payloads. 12 bots, 5 skaters + 1 goalie per team on alternating teams, fixed seed for reproducibility. Run length is set per-job by phase_seconds (default 1h), not by this playbook; the duration_seconds below is only a fallback for running BotHost standalone without --duration.
